headline_candidate: A business-process maker now combines a plain-language app, deterministic workflow and agent in Copilot Studio
source_supported_core_mechanism: The maker describes a business outcome, users, data and actions; the studio creates a draft interactive app for further conversational refinement, connects deterministic workflow steps to adaptable agent behavior, and presents governed business-process experience.
source_supported_secondary_relationships: Apps are public preview, and Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime hosting/identity/data access and lifecycle governance are public preview—not general availability.
Preview lifecycle hooks can run policy or logging logic at session start, tool calls and errors; hooks may inspect or block a tool call independently of agent decision.
Foundry IQ enterprise knowledge integration is described as generally available, while the publication Readiness Review panel is also generally available.
A concrete onboarding example uses a structured interface, repeatable workflow steps and an agent for exceptional cases.

editorial_differentiation.vs_oct9_c03: c03 is Microsoft Dynamics CRM/context and sales/service agent execution; this alternate is nontechnical building/assembling an app+workflow+agent for arbitrary business processes. If c03 is also selected, demonstrate distinct workflow and reader audiences; avoid two Microsoft stories only distinguished by product label.
editorial_differentiation.vs_oct9_c05: c05 contains the required reusable Google Cloud Agent Skills registry and grounded reporting skill; this alternate uses the app/workflow/agent division of labor and should NOT be designated the Agent Skills story.
editorial_differentiation.vs_oct9_c06: Business process composition provides richer actionable mechanism than Glean admin-governed model-selection release note.

quality_limitations: Do not describe any preview as broadly available.
An announced capability is not an independently demonstrated customer outcome.
Never imply an unapproved generated app is immediately production-ready; review, policy, evaluation and managed runtime are separate operational gates.
Source article body describes September product updates but is publisher-dated October 7; distinguish product-update month from news publication date.
Same publisher as other Microsoft c03 story creates portfolio-diversity risk.

supporting_source_scope.independently_read: Official Microsoft publisher article, text content and rollout qualifiers
